profile.name: QuTech量子控制箱
profile.description: 用于量子比特实验的200 MS/s控制与读出电子学设备。该控制箱通过串行协议进行通信，可配置AWG查找表、DAC使能与偏置、分段/条件时序带，并读取输入平均、积分平均、积分日志、量子态日志及流式采集结果，常用于量子测控与读出实验。
profile.description_en: A 200 MS/s control and readout electronics unit for qubit experiments. The control box communicates over a serial protocol and supports configuring AWG lookup tables, DAC enable and offsets, segmented/conditional timing tapes, and reading input-average, integrated-average, integration-log, qubit-state-log, and streaming acquisition results for quantum control and readout experiments.

registry.name: QuTech Qu Tech Control Box
registry.description: QU Tech Control BOX是由QuTech生产的表征设备，主要功能包括使能、停止、写入数据、初始化、加载、启动。支持Signal, Slot, add params等操作。
